description:
Use this when the user asks whether they should wear a particular gemstone (blue sapphire, emerald, pukhraj, a crystal), or whether a stone they wear suits their chart.
Answers the prescription, not the future: which planet the stone strengthens, what that planet owns from this ascendant, whether a classical rule (a dusthāna or kendrādhipati lordship, a māraka) argues against strengthening it, and whether the reason is permanent or lasts only as long as the running period. Returns a verdict — well_founded, period_bound, no_ground, contraindicated or unrecognised — with every ground for and against, the planet's capacity at its degree, when the chart puts the planet in scope, the stones the sources hold apart from it (checked against `alsoWearing`), and wearing detail (finger, metal, day, weight, with the book it comes from) only when the chart gives a reason to wear it. When the source states a caution about the stone, the response says so and names the book. A word that covers several stones ("sapphire") is answered with the candidates. Nothing here predicts what a stone does. Deterministic: no language model is called. The birth time is required.
Cost: 5 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"birthData":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209},"gem":"blue sapphire","alsoWearing":["ruby"]}

alsoWearing.description: Optional: stones already worn. When the chart puts the planet in scope, a pairing the sources hold apart is reported as a conflict.

birthData.description: The person's birth data. The time is required: every period depends on the rising sign.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, local to `timezone`. Omit if unknown: house-dependent detail is then reduced.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

gem.description: One stone, in English or by its Indian name: "yellow sapphire", "pukhraj", "emerald", "moonstone".

name: assess_gemstone

requestId.description: Quote this in any support request.

sandbox.description: Present and true only on sandbox-key responses: a fixed sample, not computed from your request.

against.description: Everything arguing against, including stones the sources hold apart from this one.

capacity.description: What the planet's degree says about its capacity to deliver.

grounds.description: Everything arguing for, each a checkable statement about ownership or period.

guidance.description: Wearing detail, only when the chart gives a reason to wear the stone.

caution.description: Whether the source states a caution about wearing the stone, and where to read it.

source.description: The book the detail was read from (title).

guidanceWithheld.description: Why the wearing detail is absent, when it is.

notModelled.description: Stated on every assessment: nothing here predicts what a stone does.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.

title: Gemstone assessment
